SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date November 11, 1931.
Subject (in full) Letter from the Wen Hwa Fine Arts Press (文華美術圖書印刷公司),
150 Point Road re Labour Unrest.
Made by D.S.I. Moore Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.O.I.

With reference to the attached letter from the
Wen Hwa Fine Arts Press, 150 Point Road, regarding the
labour situation in this concern, enquiries show that at
11 a.m. November 7, the Manager of the Press reported at
Wayside Station that he was expecting trouble at the
Works that afternoon as he had heard that the workers
were going to demand holidays on Sundays. Police and
detectives from Wayside Station were posted within call,
but nothing of an untoward nature occurred.

According to the manager, the employees have been
holding meetings nearly every night after work, either in the
World Book Store Workers' Club, Dalny Road, or in an unnumbered
dwelling house behind the Hwa Shang Tobacco Company, Kwemming
Road, but he cannot say what the meetings are about, and so
far no demands have been put forward.

This printing works has no union, and in this
connection the manager is suspicious of three employees,
whom he has heard, are trying to form a union. Their
names and occupations are Wang Chung (王忠), typesetter;
Chow Tsang Pao (周長保), Engineer; and King Yung-ling
(金永寧), typesetter, the latter being regarded as the
brains behind the scheme. All have been working in this concern
for the past two years.

At present all is quiet at the works, but the manager
states that he will get in touch with Wayside Station in the
event of any further signs of unrest among the workers.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
D. S. I.
Noted
U. O. ("D" Div.)
1931
S.O."S", Information and return
please.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 1，特别股。
报告
日期：1931年11月11日。
事由（全称）：文華美術圖書印刷公司（Wen Hwa Fine Arts Press），百老汇路150号，关于劳工骚动之来信。
由副督察长穆尔（D.S.I. Moore）呈报，经首席督察员亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson, C.O.I.）转送。

兹提及附上的文華美術圖書印刷公司（地址：百老汇路150号）关于该厂劳工状况的来信，经查询得知，11月7日上午11时，该印刷厂经理向麦特赫司脱巡捕房（Wayside Station）报告称，他听说工人们打算要求星期日休假，预计当天下午工厂内会发生麻烦。麦特赫司脱巡捕房的警员和侦探已处于待命状态，但未发生任何意外事件。

据经理称，雇员们几乎每晚下班后都在开会，地点要么在大连路的世界书局工人俱乐部，要么在昆明路华成烟草公司后面的一栋无门牌号的住宅内，但他无法说明会议内容，截至目前也未提出任何要求。

该印刷厂没有工会，就此而言，经理怀疑三名雇员正试图组建工会。他们的姓名和职业分别是：排字工王忠（Wang Chung）、工程师周長保（Chow Tsang Pao）以及排字工金永寧（King Yung-ling），其中后者被视为该计划的幕后主谋。这三人在该厂工作均已满两年。

目前工厂内一切平静，但经理表示，一旦工人中出现进一步的不安迹象，他将与麦特赫司脱巡捕房联系。

特别股主管警官。
副督察长。
已阅
U. O.（“D”分区）
1931年
S.O.“S”，请提供信息及回复。
1931年11月11日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2872.

Translation of the attached letter from the Wen Hwa
Fine Arts Press Co., corner of Point and Pudding Roads.

November 6, 1931.

Political Department,
Municipal Police.

Gentlemen,

We have to draw your attention to the action
of two of our workers named Wong Chung (王忠) and Cheu
Tsang Pao (周長保) in inciting the rest of the workers
to go on strike and coercing them to sign their names on
the list of participants. As we are afraid that the
outbreak of the strike will be detrimental to peace and
good order, we have, apart from reporting to the Wayside
Police and asking for their protection, to forward this
for your record and also request that an officer be
sent here to make an investigation so as to nip the trouble
in the bud.

(Chopped) The seal of the Wen Hwa Fine Arts
Press. 文華美術圖書印刷所

S2,
For attention
please.
JW

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事及特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2872。

附件为文華美術印刷公司（位于百老汇路与布丁路转角）来信的译文。

1931年11月6日。

警务处政治部。

诸位先生：

提请贵部注意我司两名工人王忠（Wong Chung）和周長保（Cheu Tsang Pao）的行为，他们煽动其他工人罢工，并胁迫他们在参与者名单上签名。由于担心罢工爆发会有碍和平与良好秩序，除向麦特赫司脱巡捕房报告并请求保护外，特将此信呈送贵部备案，并恳请派员前来调查，以便将祸患消灭于萌芽状态。

（盖章）文華美術圖書印刷所印章

S2，
请予关注。
JW
1937年11月7日。
